notes.title: Optimization Patch and Price Drop
notes.content:
It's been nearly half a year since the initial release and in being my first game, there were some optimizations I wasn't aware of when I released (sorry about that!).


[b]Here's what's up:[/b]
[list]
[*]The most recent patch fixes some tiny edge-case bugs and reduces the package size by over 50%! (Enjoy that extra GB, on me)
[*]Enjoy a permanent 40% off price drop and share the game with even more friends.
[*]The Steam page is simpler and snappier, with new screenshots and videos.
[/list]

Thank you for your support, everyone! And please consider leaving a review if you've tried Ball is Life.
